newsitem.title: USA: Reynolds selling plants to Kaiser.
newsitem.headline: Reynolds selling plants to Kaiser.

text.p: Reynolds Metals Co said Thursday it has a letter of intent for Kaiser Aluminum & Chemical Corp to buy its sheet and plate plant in McCook, Illinois and its extrusion plant in Bellwood, Virginia.
Reynolds said it does not expect the transaction to have a material impact on results of operations.
The McCook plant employs about 650 people and produces aluminum products for the aerospace and automotive industries. The Bellwood plant employs about 385 people, the company said.
Reynolds said sale of the plants comes after a review of its portfolio and as it attempts to streamline its business focus to improve corporate performance and strengthen its financial position.
The deal is subject to regulatory and board approvals, negotiation and execution of definitive agreements, and other closing conditions.
It is expected to close in the second quarter 1997, both companies said, adding that the two plants are expected to continue operating at current levels.
Kaiser Aluminum & Chemical Corp is the operating subsidiary of Kaiser Aluminum Corp. MAXXAM Inc holds about 62 percent of Kaiser on a fully diluted basis.
